blocks.text: Condo buildings in Ladner Elementary
Fentons Court — 4988 47A Avenue

A boutique low-rise beside the village core: a building profile records 3 floors and an estimated completion of 1990, with underground parking and storage, and 1- to 3-bedroom homes. The same profile states both "20 homes" in its text and "36" units in its details table — unit count: UNCONFIRMED until the strata plan is read. Restrictions: UNCONFIRMED.
Park Regent Estates — 4989 47 Avenue

Building-directory data (BC Condos and Homes, secondary source) records it as built in 1988, with pets allowed with restrictions and rentals allowed with restrictions, and amenities of elevator, in-suite laundry and storage. A unit listing describes it as a self-managed, pet-friendly and rental-friendly building directly across from a park, and records a 1987 build year — the year differs by source: UNCONFIRMED which is exact.
Seafarer Marina Estates — 4803 48 Avenue

Waterfront condos by the marina: listings classify homes here as Apartment/Condo, built 1985, with a 30-foot boat slip attached to at least one unit, elevator access, and a newer windows and roof noted in listing copy. Unit count and construction type: UNCONFIRMED.
Delta Green — 4686 51 Street

The sub-area's verified 55+ building: listings describe "premier 55+ living in the heart of Ladner Village directly across from Memorial Park & the library", Apartment/Condo form, built 2021, wood-frame construction, freehold strata, with a rooftop deck, fitness gym and secure bike room. Unit count: UNCONFIRMED. The 55+ restriction is listing-stated — confirm the registered age bylaw, because only a 55+ bylaw is lawful.
Bridge & Elliott — 4905 Elliott Street (site also described as 4989 Bridge Street), Ladner Village
Some secondary sources put the count at 128–129 — exact unit count: UNCONFIRMED. Wood-frame construction is the developer's stated building model, per trade coverage of Headwater.
Village Gardens, 4949 47A Avenue; Parkside Place, 5053 47 Avenue; Mountainview Terrace, 4925 Elliott Street; Apex Homes, 4829 48 Avenue
Year built, unit count, building type and restrictions for all four: UNCONFIRMED. Do not publish details for them without strata documents.
Manor House — 4569 Arthur Drive
A boutique townhouse-style strata development, recorded in listings as built in 2025, 3 storeys, inspired by late Victorian architecture — ground-oriented homes, not an apartment building.
Faireharbour — 4904 47A Avenue
A townhouse complex recorded in listings as built in 1976 — townhouses, not apartment condos.
Streets, schools and getting around Ladner Elementary

items.t: The working area is central Ladner around Ladner Elementary School at 5016 44 Avenue, Memorial Park at 5010 47 Ave, and Arthur Drive, based on the school and park addresses on SD37 and City of Delta pages. No official boundary for the sub-area is published by the City.
The village core sits west of Chilukthan Slough; the OCP's Ladner Village Core material addresses the Village's historic buildings, which shapes renovation and redevelopment in the core.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: two pockets. First, the 47 Avenue / 47A Avenue blocks east of Memorial Park — Fentons Court, Park Regent Estates and their neighbours. Second, the village core itself — Delta Green on 51 Street, the Seafarer Marina buildings on 48 Avenue by the river, and the Bridge & Elliott presale at Bridge and Elliott Streets.

Transit: route 609 runs between South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange via Arthur Drive and Ladner Trunk Road, serving the Ladner Elementary and Delta Secondary area; route 601 runs from South Delta to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) via Ladner Exchange.

Schools physically in Ladner include Ladner Elementary, 5016 44 Ave; Delta Secondary, 4615 51 St; Hawthorne Elementary, 5160 Central Ave; Holly Elementary, 4625 62 St; Neilson Grove Elementary, 5500 Admiral Blvd; and Port Guichon Elementary, 4381 46A St. Catchments are address-based — the locator result for 5016 44 Avenue is Ladner Elementary (K–7) and Delta Secondary (8–12).

Cromie Park is at 4907 42b Ave, Ladner Leisure Centre at 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent, Ladner Pioneer Library at 4683 51st Street, and Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, has the Ladner Exchange bus loop next door.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Ladner Elementary

items.t: Age bylaws: only 55+ survives — directly relevant to Delta Green: Under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1 and 123.2, a strata may restrict residents to 55 or older; any age bylaw below 55 has been invalid since Nov 24, 2022. The bylaw restricts who may live in the unit, not who may own it, and exemptions cover legacy residents, live-in caregivers, and — since May 1, 2023 — a younger spouse or partner and defined children of a qualifying resident (Strata Property Regulation 7.01).

Presale rules (REDMA) — directly relevant to Bridge & Elliott: A presale buyer must receive a disclosure statement, and under s. 21 of the Real Estate Development Marketing Act the buyer has seven days to rescind, starting on the later of signing the purchase agreement or signing the written acknowledgement of the disclosure statement; deposits are generally held in trust. Assignment terms (consent, fees) are set by the contract and disclosure statement — no published Bridge & Elliott assignment term was verified: UNCONFIRMED.

Delta zoning: Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, and the village development permit areas: Zoning is parcel-by-parcel under Bylaw No. 7600, and the OCP adds the Ladner Village (LV1) and Ladner Village Core (LVC) development permit areas — the LVC guidelines address the Village's historic buildings and shape exterior work in the core, which matters for Delta Green, Seafarer and any village-core strata renovation.

OCP: Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), "Housing Our Future": A single consolidated plan — no lettered schedules, no Ladner area-plan schedule (the former Ladner Area Plan was a schedule of the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950); farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)". The village's six-storey permission that Bridge & Elliott used came through the December 2021 Ladner Village OCP amendment.

SSMUH: Bylaws 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024: Delta's SSMUH zoning allows combinations of single detached dwellings, duplexes, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies.

Property transfer tax: General PTT is 1% on the first $200,000, 2% from $200,000 to $2 million, 3% above $2 million, plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3 million. The first-time buyers' exemption removes the tax on the first $500,000 (maximum saving $8,000) at $835,000 or less, phasing out to $860,000; the newly built home exemption is full to $1,100,000 and phases out by $1,150,000.

Mortgage default insurance: CMHC's published homeowner premium schedule runs from 0.60% of the loan at loan-to-value up to 65%, to 4.00% at 90.01%–95% LTV, and 4.50% at that top band with a non-traditional down payment.

blocks.text: Good to know about Ladner Elementary

items.t: Bridge & Elliott is the village's density turning point. Trade coverage notes multifamily housing has rarely been available in Ladner Village, that Delta council approved the OCP amendment for Ladner Village in December 2021 allowing buildings up to six storeys on the Headwater site, and that the project is now in presale/under construction — the first six-storey condo building in the village core.

The Highway 99 crossing is being rebuilt — on a new budget and timeline. On July 6, 2026, the Province announced an updated total budget of $8.5 billion for the Fraser River Tunnel Project, the eight-lane immersed-tube tunnel replacing the George Massey Tunnel, with the federal government contributing up to $3 billion and major construction expected to begin in 2027.

Ladner Village revitalization is an active City program. The City's Ladner Village Revitalization Action Plan, including the Chisholm Street Wharf project, is the named project set for the core where Delta Green and Bridge & Elliott sit.

The newest resale stock is very new, and very small-scale. Manor House on Arthur Drive completed in 2025 as a boutique townhouse-style strata, and Delta Green added a 55+ apartment building in 2021 — central Ladner's condo supply is growing a few units at a time, not in towers.

The sub-area name is a school name, not a catchment promise. SD37 catchments are address-based; a home marketed as "Ladner Elementary area" can still fall to Port Guichon Elementary or another school — the locator result in is for the school's own address only.
There is no Ladner Elementary market data in the standard stats pack.

items.t: Where the townhouse stock actually concentrates: the village-core blocks themselves. Faireharbour and the older strata stock sit on 47A Avenue east of Memorial Park; Manor House stands on Arthur Drive; Apex Homes and the fee-simple 48 Landing row houses stand on 48 Avenue / 48B Street by the river side of the core. The apartment condos concentrate in the same blocks — the two forms interleave here more than anywhere else in Ladner.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Ladner Elementary

items.t: Form B first (strata complexes only): Under s. 59 of the Strata Property Act, the Form B Information Certificate discloses the unit's monthly strata fees, amounts the owner owes, approved-but-unpaid special levies, the contingency reserve fund (CRF) balance, parking and storage allocations, and a summary of the strata's insurance; the strata must provide it within 7 days of a request, and the rules, current budget and most recent depreciation report must be attached. Manor House, Faireharbour and Apex Homes purchases run on this document; a 48 Landing purchase has no Form B at all.

Fee-simple, plainly: A 48 Landing row house has NO strata corporation, NO Form B and NO strata fees — the buyer deals with municipal rules (zoning, the village development permit areas below) and any covenants or easements on title only. Insurance, exterior maintenance and drainage are entirely the owner's.

Depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle (strata): Since July 1, 2024, strata corporations with five or more strata lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years and can no longer defer it by a vote; reports carry a 30-year projection and three CRF cash-flow models. For 1976-built Faireharbour, that report is the central diligence document.

CRF minimum 10% (strata): Since November 1, 2023, a strata corporation must contribute a minimum of 10% of the annual operating fund to the contingency reserve fund when approving the budget at the AGM.

Rental-restriction bylaws are void (strata): As of Nov 24, 2022, no BC strata may have a residential rental-restriction bylaw — all existing ones are invalid, whatever an older directory entry says. Stratas may still ban or limit short-term rentals by bylaw. Any "rentals not allowed" line for a complex in this sub-area is void in-entry for long-term rentals.

Age bylaws: only 55+ survives (strata): Under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1 and 123.2, a strata may restrict residents to 55 or older; any age bylaw below 55 has been invalid since Nov 24, 2022, and exemptions (Strata Property Regulation 7.01) cover legacy residents, live-in caregivers, and — since May 1, 2023 — a younger spouse or partner and defined children of a qualifying resident. The bylaw restricts who may live in the unit, not who may own it. No townhouse complex in this sub-area is verified as 55+; the sub-area's verified 55+ building (Delta Green) is apartment form.

Presale / new-construction rules (REDMA) — relevant to Bridge & Elliott and to any developer-sold townhouse: A presale buyer must receive a disclosure statement, and under s. 21 of the Real Estate Development Marketing Act the buyer has seven days to rescind, starting on the later of signing the purchase agreement or signing the written acknowledgement of the disclosure statement; deposits are generally held in trust. The disclosure-statement duty sits in REDMA s. 18's framework. Assignment terms are set by the contract and disclosure statement — no published assignment term for a complex here was verified: UNCONFIRMED.

Delta zoning — number CONTESTED, flagged not settled, plus the village permit areas: City zone sheets cite the zoning bylaw as No. 7600, 2017, parcel by parcel; an internal consolidated title reading "8400, 2025" also circulates — neither number is asserted as settled here. On top of zoning, the OCP's Ladner Village (LV1) and Ladner Village Core (LVC) development permit areas apply in the core — the LVC guidelines address the Village's historic buildings and shape exterior work, which matters for strata exterior renovations and for a fee-simple row house alike.

SSMUH / suites as Delta states them: Delta adopted its SSMUH zoning amendments as Bylaws 8394 and 8395 on June 24, 2024, allowing combinations of single detached dwellings, duplexes, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies; the RS1 zone also lists a secondary suite as an accessory use. Inside a strata complex the bylaws sit on top; on a fee-simple lot the municipal permission is the whole test (plus title covenants).

GST on new construction: 48 Landing homes and any developer-sold new townhouse carry GST; resale townhomes do not. The first-time home buyers' GST/HST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026, per CRA News No. 122) rebates 100% of the GST up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million, for agreements in the March 20, 2025–2031 window; the older GST New Housing Rebate is 36% of the GST, maximum $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000.

Down-payment programs and mortgage insurance: The Home Buyers' Plan allows up to $60,000 per person from RRSPs for a first home, and the First Home Savings Account allows $8,000 per year to a $40,000 lifetime limit; the two can be combined. CMHC's published homeowner premium schedule runs 0.6%–4.5% of the loan across its loan-to-value bands.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Ladner Elementary
Fee-simple lots

items.t: The default tenure in this sub-area is fee-simple: single detached dwellings on fee-simple lots under the single detached residential zones, with secondary suites as an accessory use in RS1 and SSMUH options under the City's amendments. Fee-simple plainly: no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees.
48 Landing — 4778 / 4788 48B Street.: New construction — GST applies to the home purchase.

Lot character as the research states it: the urban Ladner ladder runs RS7 335 m² and RS6 390 m² up to RD1 duplex 836 m², with RS1–RS3 and RD2–RD3 at 4,000 m² in lower-density areas; the zone on any parcel is read off the City zoning maps. The feed itself surfaced detached houses and a building-lot listing (on Whitworth Crescent / 47a Avenue in the feed's street list) — the occasional vacant-lot trade inside a built fabric, not a development. No area-wide lot-size profile beyond the ladder: UNVERIFIED beyond this.

blocks.text: Bare-land strata

items.t: A bare-land strata lot IS strata tenure: the buyer owns the strata lot (essentially the building lot itself) and the house on it; Form B, strata fees for common property and registered bylaws apply to the lot. It is NOT fee-simple. The strata complexes the feed names in this sub-area (Manor House, Riverwest, Harbourside, Mountainview Terrace — feed copy only, details UNVERIFIED in the research) are built strata housing, not bare-land strata lots.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Ladner Elementary

items.t: Subdivision / servicing — process documented, number not asserted: a Development and Subdivision Standards Bylaw No. 8288, 2024 (repealing No. 506.

Streamside / flood diligence the research documents: all Delta properties within 30 m of a stream — including Chilukthan Slough and drainage ditches — are in the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area. Delta's flood protection (dikes, seawalls, foreshore protection; over 63 km of infrastructure, 31 pump stations, ~538 km of drainage) frames every low Ladner lot; flood construction requirements are lot-specific.

ALR block (where ALR ground is met): ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALR subdivision requires ALC approval. Caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class — three-tier, in full: $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31.

Bare-land strata block (the form, for any strata lot a buyer meets in Ladner): Form B (SPA s. 59) — fees, amounts owed, approved levies, CRF balance, insurance summary, with rules, budget and most recent depreciation report attached; within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page. Depreciation reports every 5 years for 5+ lots since July 1, 2024. CRF minimum 10% since November 1, 2023. Rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (long-term; short-term may still be restricted). Only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Reg 7.01, incl. May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw. Fee-simple contrast — 48 Landing and the grid's lots carry none of this.

Presales (REDMA) — Bridge & Elliott: disclosure statement required (s. 18, deposits in trust); 7-day rescission from the later of signing or acknowledging it (s. 21). Assignment terms: contract-specific, UNCONFIRMED for this project.
Speculation / prohibition: SVT taxable areas include the City of Delta; per-parcel SVT UNCONFIRMED.

blocks.text: Good to know about Ladner Elementary

items.t: The sub-area is named for a school, and the spelling rule cuts the other way nearby. The AREA next door is "Neilsen Grove" while its SCHOOL is "Neilson Grove Elementary" (5500 Admiral Blvd) — the two spellings are both correct, for different things, and a search built on the wrong one misses stock.
The catchment here was settled on paper, not by a locator run.

A fee-simple row house is the exception that proves the fabric. Most new attached product in Ladner is strata; 48 Landing's non-strata form means its owners hold plain fee-simple lots in the downtown grid — no depreciation report, no CRF, no Form B on resale.

The village core's heritage layer predates any lot split. The LVC permit area's historic-building guidelines sit on village-core parcels before zoning math does — a "subdividable" village lot can still be design-constrained.
Page-statement check for this area. Correct email program-wide: jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca. ladner-mobile-homes is an intentional 404 (deleted Oct 23, 2026), never a live page or defect.

faq.q: Where are the parks and recreation facilities in this part of Ladner?
faq.a: Memorial Park (5010 47 Ave) and Cromie Park (4907 42b Ave) are City of Delta parks in central Ladner, and Ladner Leisure Centre is at 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Ladner?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Ladner?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Ladner?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: My spouse is under 55 — can we live at Delta Green?
faq.a: Delta Green is marketed as 55+ living. Provincial rules require an exemption for a younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the age requirement (or holds a legacy exemption); children can also be exempt in defined cases, and a live-in caregiver is exempt. Confirm the building's registered bylaw itself before relying on the marketing.

faq.q: Can I buy at Delta Green as an investment and rent it out?
faq.a: Ownership is not age-restricted — the bylaw governs who may reside — and long-term rental-restriction bylaws are void province-wide. But a tenant must still satisfy the 55+ bylaw or an exemption, which narrows the rental pool by design.

faq.q: I signed at Bridge & Elliott — how long do I have to change my mind?
faq.a: Seven days under REDMA s. 21, from the later of signing the purchase agreement or acknowledging the disclosure statement, by written notice to the developer. After that, the contract binds — including its assignment terms.

faq.q: Does a presale here get taxed differently from a resale?
faq.a: Yes. A new home carries 5% GST (partly recoverable — up to 100% for eligible first-time buyers to $1 million under Bill C-4), and PTT is charged on the total paid; the newly built home PTT exemption is full to $1,100,000. A resale condo has no GST.

faq.q: What comes with a Seafarer Marina unit — is the boat slip real?
faq.a: A current listing describes a unit with its own 30-foot boat slip and river views from a large deck. Whether a slip is assigned, leased or part of the strata lot is a title and Form B question for the specific unit — do not assume the slip transfers on marketing copy alone.

faq.q: What is the actual townhouse choice in the village core?
faq.a: Four verified complexes in two tenures: strata townhouses at Manor House (2025), Faireharbour (1976) and Apex Homes (2025), and fee-simple non-strata row houses at 48 Landing (2026). Everything else named for this sub-area is either an apartment building or UNCONFIRMED.

faq.q: What is the practical difference between 48 Landing and Manor House?
faq.a: Tenure. Manor House is strata: monthly fees, bylaws, a Form B, a CRF and a depreciation report. 48 Landing is fee-simple: no fees and no bylaws, but also no strata carrying the roof, exterior or shared systems — and as new construction it carries GST, partly recoverable for eligible first-time buyers under Bill C-4.

faq.q: Faireharbour was built in 1976 — what should I check first?
faq.a: The depreciation report and the minutes. A strata of five or more lots must refresh its depreciation report every five years since July 1, 2024; its envelope, roof and drainage items, plus the CRF balance and any approved-but-unpaid levy on the Form B, are the purchase.
